g.text: ⚠️ 核心机制对比：优雅退出 vs 异常硬中断

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • 默认机制 (CP2-13)：若无退出防护，超步达到 recursion_limit (10) 时，

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #dc2626

g.text: 框架将直接抛出 GraphRecursionError 异常，导致全流程崩溃且丢失未保存结果。

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • 优雅降级 (CP2-12)：在路由函数中检查 state['remaining_steps'] < 3，

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #059669

g.text: 在步数耗尽前主动返回 END，调用总结节点产出保底答卷，实现系统高可用！

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a
